title: Work Backwards — Crab
motion_prompt: Over three seconds, the same terra-cotta crab quietly scuttles a short distance backward to the left inside its card and settles. Maintain its orientation, two claws, six walking legs and scale. Fix the camera, card, gold border, lighting, backdrop and workbench. No trails, arrows, symbols, sounds, effects or celebration. Interpolate from first.png to last.png and hold briefly; do not loop.

allow: Play once when the child intentionally inspects this card.
Play once when the child intentionally selects this card.
stop: Stop on navigation away or when the card closes.
Use the static first frame when reduced motion is requested.
forbid: Never trigger from answer correctness, a conjecture result, a gate result, a hint rung, or a tutor evaluation.
Never animate a card to recommend, automatically select, or imply that its strategy is appropriate.
No autoplay on encounter arrival, timers, points, counts, sound effects, or celebration.
